channel.description: The Topic Explorer's daily movers list: which of the tracked UN-relevant topics are rising or falling in worldwide Wikipedia attention, published figures only. Decision support, not a measure of media coverage or public opinion.

item.title: Topic movers 2026-08-16: Dengue fever +2102%, Earthquake +441%, International Criminal Court -61%
item.description:
Topic movers, measured through 2026-08-16: attention in the 7 days to that date compared with the prior 30 days.

Rising

  • Dengue fever +2102%
  • Earthquake +441%
  • Inflation +434%
  • Debt relief +171%
  • Energy poverty +146% (driven by English Wikipedia)

Falling

  • International Criminal Court -61% (driven by English Wikipedia)
  • Wind power -43%
  • Wildfire -42% (driven by English Wikipedia)
  • Polio -40%
  • Computer security -34% (driven by English Wikipedia)

181 topics measured in 22 languages; 2 tracked topics could not be measured today (no current data, too little traffic, or quarantined as non-organic) and are excluded rather than scored from stale figures. Velocity is measured from Wikipedia reading patterns per language edition, volume-weighted: what people look up, not what media publish. Attention trends are decision support, never a measure of media coverage or public opinion.

Open the Topic Explorer for detail, language breakdowns and custom date ranges.
